items.summary: NHC Public Advisory 23A (11:00 PM MST / 11:00 PM PDT Mon Oct 12): Simon weakened to Category 1 with max sustained winds of 90 mph, down from 100 mph (Cat 2) in Advisory 23 at 8 PM MST. Center at 20.5N 107.1W, moving NW at 3 mph, pressure 977 mb. Flooding rains continue along the west-central Mexico coast.
items.title: Hurricane Simon weakens to Category 1 (90 mph) off Mexico

items.summary: NHC Tropical Weather Outlook 11 PM PDT Mon Oct 12: Invest EP93 south of southern Mexico shows improved signs of organization with increased shower/thunderstorm activity; formation chance remains near 100% (48h and 7d). A tropical depression or tropical storm is expected to form well south of southern Mexico within the next day or so, moving WNW ~10 mph. Still unnamed (next name: Trudy); NHC advises southwestern Mexico interests to keep monitoring.
items.title: EP93 (future Trudy) organizes south of Mexico; formation expected within a day or so
